waypoints.name: SR-20 Hairpin / Pond Pullout (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: Same pullout used for the Kangaroo Temple/West Route approach on the outside of the SR-20 hairpin; no permit required.
waypoints.directions: Park in the pullout at the hairpin turn on SR-20, a short distance east of Washington Pass at around 5,100 feet — the same roadside pullout used for the nearby West Route approach on Kangaroo Temple. No permit is required to park or climb from here.

waypoints.name: Early Winters Creek (West Face turnoff)
waypoints.note: The West Face line crosses the creek near here; for the south face, stay on the climbers' trail on the west side of the creek and keep heading up-valley.

waypoints.name: Big Kangaroo Summit
waypoints.note: Final 20-ft exposed, unprotected slab move tops out at the small summit bolt shared with the Southwest Rib/West Route.
waypoints.directions: From the last belay scramble about 20 ft up and left to the notch between the south face and the true summit, which stands a few hundred feet higher. To tag it, drop about 150 ft of scree on the far side, cross north into the West Route gully and climb its short pitches, finishing with the exposed, essentially unprotected 5.6 slab move past a single old 1/4-inch bolt.
